name: carpatics
description: Search live classified listings in Moldova and Romania and estimate typical prices.

interface.longDescription:
Carpatics is a classifieds marketplace for Moldova (carpatics.md) and Romania (carpatics.ro). This plugin lets ChatGPT search the live listings and read their details, so answers are based on what is actually for sale or for rent today, with a link to each listing on the website.

What you can ask:
- Find listings in plain words, in English, Romanian or Russian: cars and motorbikes, apartments, houses and land, electronics and other goods, jobs and services - for example "BMW X5 diesel under 20,000 EUR in Chisinau" or "2-room apartment for rent in Bucharest".
- Open a listing's details: price, specifications, city, photos and the link.
- See which categories and markets can be searched.
- Estimate the typical price band of comparable listings for a car or a property, and check an asking price against it.

Read-only and public data only: no account is needed. Private sellers are shown as "private seller" (no names or phone numbers), CVs are never returned, and contacting a seller or publishing happens on the website.
defaultPrompt: Find a used BMW X5 under 20,000 EUR in Moldova
What does a used 2018 Toyota RAV4 cost in Romania?

positive.description: List the searchable categories and markets
positive.prompt: What categories can I search on Carpatics?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the markets (Moldova, Romania) and the categories and subcategories that can be searched, with their ids.

positive.description: Search car listings in plain words
positive.prompt: Find a used BMW X5 in Moldova on Carpatics.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current BMW X5 listings from carpatics.md, newest first, each with price, year, city and a link to the listing on the website.

positive.prompt: Caut un apartament cu 2 camere de vânzare în Chișinău pe Carpatics.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current 2-room apartments for sale in Chisinau with price, surface, city and a link; private sellers appear as "private seller".

positive.description: Open the details of a listing found by a search
positive.prompt: Find a used Toyota car in Moldova on Carpatics and show me the full details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the listing's title, price, specifications, city, photos and its link, without any seller phone number or name.

positive.description: Estimate a typical price, asking for the condition first
positive.prompt: How much does a 2018 BMW X5 cost in Moldova?
positive.expected_behavior: If the condition is not known the tool answers that it needs it (new or used); with condition used it returns the typical price band, the median and the number of comparable listings in Moldova.

negative.description: Publishing a listing is not supported (read-only)
negative.prompt: Publish an ad on Carpatics for my 2015 Volkswagen Passat for 8,000 EUR.

negative.description: Seller contact details are never disclosed
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number of the seller of this Carpatics listing.

negative.description: Payments and purchases are not supported
negative.prompt: Buy this car for me and pay the seller.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; it only reads public listings.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: listing search, listing details, categories and price estimates for Moldova and Romania.
